name: Grovewarden Sethisal
bio: Sethisal is the next link in the chain of Grovewardens, an order of warriors whose sole duty is to protect the Puregrove from the predations of Malice and his Darkborn. Like his forebears, Sethisal doesn't speak much. He chooses to let his giant mace speak for him. And it yells at great volume.
